test-set.name: schema-structure
test-set.description: The schema element, the Schematron namespace, foreign markup, whitespace and documentation elements.

test-case.name: struct-minimal-valid
test-case.description: One pattern, one rule, one assert that holds everywhere: no findings.

test-case.name: struct-minimal-invalid
test-case.description: One assert that fails for one item.

finding.message: The n of an item is not 2.

test-case.name: struct-other-prefix
test-case.description: The Schematron namespace bound to a prefix other than sch.

test-case.name: struct-default-namespace
test-case.description: The Schematron namespace as the default namespace of the schema; unprefixed names in a rule context still name elements in no namespace.

test-case.name: struct-foreign-markup
test-case.description: Foreign elements and attributes anywhere in the schema are allowed and do not change validation.

test-case.name: struct-foreign-in-message
test-case.description: A foreign element inside a message: the message text includes its text.

test-case.name: struct-whitespace
test-case.description: Whitespace children anywhere and leading or trailing whitespace in attributes; message whitespace is collapsed.

test-case.name: struct-documentation
test-case.description: title and p in schema, pattern and rule are documentation only.

test-case.name: struct-rich-attributes
test-case.description: icon, see, fpi, xml:lang and xml:space on schema, pattern, rule and assert have no effect on validity.

test-case.name: struct-xml11
test-case.description: A schema that is an XML 1.1 document.

test-case.name: struct-empty-instance-element
test-case.description: An instance whose only element no rule matches is valid.

test-case.name: ns-prefix-differs
test-case.description: The prefix ns declares differs from the instance's prefix for the same URI: names match by URI.

test-case.name: ns-default-namespace-instance
test-case.description: The instance uses a default namespace; the schema names it with a prefix.

test-case.name: ns-unprefixed-no-namespace
test-case.description: An unprefixed name in a query names an element in no namespace: it does not match elements in the instance's default namespace.

test-case.name: ns-same-prefix-other-uri
test-case.description: The schema and the instance bind one prefix to different URIs: the schema's binding decides, and nothing matches.

test-case.name: ns-one-prefix-two-uris
test-case.description: Two ns elements bind one prefix to two URIs.

result.implementation-defined: 5.4.10 does not say whether a prefix may be declared twice: a processor may reject the schema, use the first binding (no findings) or the last (one successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{urn:example:two}item[1]).

test-case.name: ns-duplicate-declaration
test-case.description: Two identical ns elements: the binding is the same, and nothing in the standard forbids repeating it.

test-case.name: ns-xmlns-conflict
test-case.description: The schema's root binds a prefix with xmlns to one URI and ns binds it to another: queries use the ns binding only.

test-case.name: ns-xml-prefix
test-case.description: ns may declare the xml prefix with its fixed URI; xml:lang is then usable in tests.

test-case.name: ns-non-ascii-prefix
test-case.description: A prefix with a non-ASCII letter.

test-case.name: struct-utf16
test-case.description: A schema encoded in UTF-16, with non-ASCII text in a message.
